name: termi
description: Secure server management PWA - SSH, SCP, RDP, VNC from your browser
author: Termi Contributors

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/gateway
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev" "npm run dev:gateway" "ELECTRON_DEV=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL=ws://127.0.0.1:22081 electron ."
scripts.build:web-standalone: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && cp -r apps/web/.next/static apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static && cp -r apps/web/public apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/public
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:web-standalone && rm -rf apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next/node_modules && npm run build:gateway-bundle && electron-builder
